bio: Joinery in a Copenhagen workshop. Oak, chisels and the sound of a plane taking a perfect curl.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his 40s with a grey beard and kind eyes wearing a canvas apron and safety glasses on his head, workshop light, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a warm wooden workshop with hand tools on a wall and oak planks, sawdust in sunbeams, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: At the bench
videos: A hand plane and a perfect shaving

videos.title: A hand plane and a perfect shaving
videos.description: One long curl of oak coming off the plane.
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand plane taking a long thin curl of pale oak, sawdust in a sunbeam, shallow depth of field, no face, no text
videos.motion: The plane glides forward and a long curl of wood rises and spirals off, sawdust glitters in the light.

videos.title: Dovetails by hand
videos.description: Saw, chisel and a joint that closes with a whisper.
videos.still: Wide photograph of two pieces of oak with hand-cut dovetails being fitted together on a workbench with chisels and a saw nearby, warm light, hands only, no text
videos.motion: The two boards slide together slowly and the joint closes tight, dust floats, subtle camera push-in.

videos.title: Workshop, first light
videos.description: Sunbeams across a quiet workshop before the day starts.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a quiet woodworking shop in morning sunbeams with tools hanging on a wall and sawdust floating, no people, no text
videos.motion: Dust motes drift slowly in the sunbeams, light creeps along the wall, slow gentle push-in.

videos.title: Oiling a walnut table
videos.description: The first coat of oil makes the grain jump.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a hand wiping oil onto a walnut tabletop making the grain glow, a rag and a jar of oil, warm light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hand wipes across the walnut and the grain deepens in colour, slow top-down drift.
